info.name: Nest RMS Learn
info.description:
API collection for nest-rms-learn.

## Quick start
1. Import this collection + the environment.
2. Select environment **Nest RMS Local**.
3. Start the API (`npm run start:dev`).
4. Run **Auth → Login** (or Register). Tests save `token` + `refreshToken`.
5. Call any Bearer-protected request.

## Surfaces
- `/app/...` — customer app (`app:access`)
- `/dashboard/...` — staff/admin (`dashboard:access` + resource permissions)
- `/auth`, `/health` — public

Responses (except health) are wrapped: `{ statusCode, data, path, timestamp }`.
